scope: Obstfeld and Rogoff (1996), Chapter 4: the real exchange rate and the terms of trade. Price levels, PPP and the law of one price; CRS production and the factor-price frontier; the Balassa-Samuelson model with exact log-derivative results and corrected sign claims; extensions (three factors, immobile capital); the long-run GDP and GNP lines; productivity growth and nontradables employment; the CES price index with duality and Cobb-Douglas limits; consumption dynamics with the consumption-based real interest rate; endogenous labour supply (Appendix 4A); costly capital mobility with a saddle-point theorem (Appendix 4B); the Dornbusch-Fischer-Samuelson continuum model: cutoff existence, comparative statics, real wages, current-account dynamics, transport costs and the price index. Exercises 1-8.
source: Maurice Obstfeld and Kenneth Rogoff (1996), Foundations of International Macroeconomics, MIT Press, Chapter 4, pp. 199-268.
